newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ATHLETICS-MATTHEUS WINS 1997 COMRADES MARATHON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MATTHEUS WINS 1997 COMRADES MARATHON.

text.p: South Africa's Charl Mattheus, disqualified after crossing the line first in the 1992 race, won the 1997 Comrades Marathon title on Monday when he beat fellow South African Nick Bester into second place by just over two minutes.
The 32-year-old Mattheus, deprived of the title five years ago after taking a banned substance before the marathon for a cold, posted a time of five hours 28 minutes and 37 seconds.
Bester finished in a time of 5:30:41 while Poland's Jaroslaw Janicki placed third in 5:32:50.
Men's marathon unofficial times (South African unless stated):
1. Charl Mattheus five hours 28 minutes 37 seconds
